note: A member's reading of the header block of each of the 50 policies in policies.json (doctypes R35), written by DOCTYPES #2 on 2026-10-07 from the documents themselves (for the three image-only scans, from the page images), before any policy reader existed, and never from a reader's output. `type` is the series (`ai`, `dgo`, `so`); dates are the calendar date the header prints (two-digit years read 00-49 as 20xx, 50-99 as 19xx); every other field is the text the header gives it. For an order fronted by a revision memorandum, the header is the order's own. A field the header does not print, or prints with no value, is absent. `title` is the order's own name as its first page prints it.
